Diagram.gridLines: Insert or remove rows and columns
Diagram.gridLinesBlocked: Rows and columns cannot be changed right now: two people share a cell, or the layout overrides have reached their limit. Use “Reset to automatic layout” to discard the overrides.
Diagram.insertColumnAt: Insert an empty column before column {n}
Diagram.insertRowAt: Insert an empty row before row {n}
Diagram.resizeWidth: Change the box width (drag the right edge of the top-left box)
Diagram.resizeHeight: Change the box height (drag the bottom edge of the top-left box)
Diagram.resizeBoth: Change the box size (drag the corner of the top-left box)
Diagram.columnGap: Column gap {value}px (drag sideways, or use the arrow keys)
Diagram.rowGap: Row gap {value}px (drag up and down, or use the arrow keys)
Diagram.discardNote: Unsaved layout changes will be lost.
Diagram.resetTitle: Reset everything to the automatic layout?
Diagram.resetNote: Every manual placement and box size returns to the default. Nothing is committed until you save.
Diagram.emptyState: Open a diagram file (.diagram.json) to see the chart here.
Diagram.addElement: Add an element to an empty cell
Diagram.addElementAt: Add an element at column {column}, row {row}
Diagram.groupsUndeclared: This chart declares no group axes. Add one to groups in the file to pick values here.
Diagram.renameTaken: "{name}" is already in the chart. Choose another name.
Diagram.familyLineNotDeletable: A family line cannot be deleted here. Deleting it means deleting the family, so remove the element instead.
Diagram.insertAbove: Insert a gap above (push this column down)
Diagram.insertLeft: Insert a gap to the left (push this row right)
Diagram.insertAboveBlocked: No room above "{name}": this column is full all the way down.
Diagram.insertLeftBlocked: No room left of "{name}": this row is full all the way right.
Diagram.connectFromLine: Draw a line from this line’s midpoint
Diagram.familyAnchor: Junction of the family line for {parents}
Diagram.removedWithFamilies: Removed "{name}". {families} family(ies) and their lines went with it; {rescued} stayed as name-only elements.
